items.name: Suite Command Router
items.description: Top-level entry point for status, opportunity discovery, snapshots, earnings and maintenance.

items.name: Opportunity Finder
items.description: Search and filter the canonical opportunity catalog used by the website.

items.name: Earnings Tracker
items.description: Record attempts and verified earnings in a persistent JSON ledger.

items.name: Opportunity Snapshot
items.description: Create timestamped snapshots of the canonical opportunity catalog. This is not a live scrape.

items.name: New Case Generator
items.description: Create a standardized research case with metadata, notes, attempts and evidence directories.

items.name: Repository Maintenance Check
items.description: Compile core tools and report repository hygiene, version drift and suspicious files.
